description: This file defines a singleton-like enum 'OpenClawConfigFile' that manages reading, writing, and observing configuration data stored in JSON format. It includes functions for loading and saving configuration dictionaries, handling gateway settings, control flags, workspace settings, and logging activities. It also performs integrity checks and creates audit logs for configuration changes and inconsistencies.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL for the config file used to load/store configuration data.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the directory where config-related state files, like logs, are stored.

methods.name: defaultWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Provides the default URL for workspace directory configuration.

methods.name: loadDict
methods.description: Loads and parses the configuration data from the file, returning a dictionary or empty if unavailable.

methods.name: saveDict
methods.description: Serializes and writes the given dictionary as JSON to the config file, with audit logging and consistency checks.

methods.name: loadGatewayDict
methods.description: Returns the 'gateway' subsection from the main configuration dictionary.

methods.name: updateGatewayDict
methods.description: Allows modification of the 'gateway' subsection within the config data.

methods.name: browserControlEnabled
methods.description: Checks if browser control is enabled based on config data, returns a default if unspecified.

methods.name: setBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Sets the browser control enabled flag in the configuration data.

methods.name: agentWorkspace
methods.description: Gets the current agent workspace setting from the config.

methods.name: setAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Updates the agent workspace setting within the configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the stored password for the gateway, if configured.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the configured port number for the gateway, if present.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the port portion of the remote gateway URL, if configured.

methods.name: setRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Sets the remote gateway URL in the configuration based on host and port.

methods.name: clearRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Removes the remote gateway URL configuration.

methods.name: hostKey
methods.description: Returns a normalized key for a hostname to be used in matching or comparison.

methods.name: parseConfigData
methods.description: Attempts to parse raw JSON data into a configuration dictionary, supporting JSON5 if available.

methods.name: stampMeta
methods.description: Adds metadata such as app version and timestamp to the config dictionary.

methods.name: hasMeta
methods.description: Checks if metadata exists within a configuration dictionary.

methods.name: gatewayMode
methods.description: Extracts the 'mode' field from the gateway configuration subsection.

methods.name: configWriteSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Analyzes potential anomalies during config writes, such as size drops or missing metadata, returning reasons.

methods.name: configAuditLogURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for audit logs related to configuration writes.

methods.name: configHealthStateURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for storing config health state information.

methods.name: readConfigHealthState
methods.description: Reads and returns the current health state of the configuration from disk.

methods.name: writeConfigHealthState
methods.description: Writes the health state back to disk in JSON format.

methods.name: configHealthEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific health entry for a given config path.

methods.name: setConfigHealthEntry
methods.description: Updates or adds a health entry for a specific config path.

methods.name: isUpdateChannelOnlyRoot
methods.description: Detects if the config root contains only an 'update' channel, indicating a specific update-only state.

methods.name: fileTimestampMs
methods.description: Converts file timestamp attributes into milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: fileAttributeInt
methods.description: Converts file attribute values into integers, handling NSNumber and Int types.

methods.name: fileSystemNumber
methods.description: Converts file system number attributes into string representations.

methods.name: posixMode
methods.description: Extracts POSIX permission bits from file attribute data.

methods.name: configFingerprint
methods.description: Generates a fingerprint dictionary including hash, size, timestamps, and other file metadata for a config file.

methods.name: sameFingerprint
methods.description: Determines if two fingerprint dictionaries are equivalent.

methods.name: observeSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Analyzes if the current config differs significantly from a known good state, pointing out reasons for suspicion.

methods.name: readConfigFingerprint
methods.description: Reads and computes fingerprint data for a given config file URL.

methods.name: configTimestampToken
methods.description: Sanitizes timestamp string for filename usage by replacing colons and dots.

methods.name: persistClobberedSnapshot
methods.description: Saves a backup copy of a clobbered config file with a timestamped filename.

methods.name: observeConfigRead
methods.description: Performs integrity checks and logs when a config file is read, detecting and recording anomalies.

methods.name: appendConfigWriteAudit
methods.description: Logs details about a successful or failed config write operation.

methods.name: appendConfigObserveAudit
methods.description: Logs details when a config read operation detects anomalies.
